title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Paracoccidioidomycosis in the Maxillofacial Region: A Report of 5 Cases
case_text:
A 48-year-old male patient who was a rural worker presented to the clinic, and he denied habits, addictions, or comorbidities. His main complaint was a "bleeding wound in the mouth." Clinical examination revealed an ulcer lesion of approximately 4 cm associated with hemorrhagic dots (Figure 10).
PMC was confirmed after anatomopathological examination. Therapy started promptly with trimethoprim + sulfamethoxazole.
